entries.name: ponytail

why.zh: 「DietrichGebert/ponytail」是 AI Agent 生态里的通用项目；聚焦 Agent 技能、AI Agent、Claude、Claude Code 等方向；主要使用 JavaScript。
why.en: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote. A project in the AI agent ecosystem, mainly written in JavaScript, focused on Agent Skills, AI Agents, Claude, Claude Code.

highlights.zh: 有完整可复现的基准测试（benchmarks/ 目录），不是纯营销数字
highlights.en: Ships a fully reproducible benchmark (benchmarks/ directory), not just marketing numbers

highlights.zh: npm 一行安装，兼容 20+ 编码代理（Claude Code、Cursor 等）
highlights.en: One-line npm install, compatible with 20+ coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.)

highlights.zh: MIT 协议，产品化程度高（logo、多语言文档、waitlist）
highlights.en: MIT licensed, highly productized (branding, i18n docs, waitlist)

cons.zh: 收益依赖任务类型：代码本已精简的场景提升接近于零
cons.en: Gains depend on task type: near zero where code is already minimal

fitFor.zh: 觉得 AI 生成的代码过度设计的开发者
fitFor.en: Developers tired of AI over-building

fitFor.zh: 控制 LLM 编码成本的团队
fitFor.en: Teams optimizing LLM coding costs

entries.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.

entries.name: Agent-Reach

why.zh: 「Panniantong/Agent-Reach」是 AI Agent 生态里的通用项目；聚焦 agent-infrastructure、AI Agent、ai-search、自动化 等方向；主要使用 Python。
why.en: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees. A project in the AI agent ecosystem, mainly written in Python, focused on agent-infrastructure, AI Agents, ai-search, Automation.

highlights.zh: CLI + Claude Code/Cursor 插件双形态，开箱即用
highlights.en: Both a CLI and Claude Code/Cursor plugins, ready out of the box

highlights.zh: 中文开发者主导，文档覆盖中/英/日/韩四语
highlights.en: Led by a Chinese developer, docs in Chinese/English/Japanese/Korean

highlights.zh: 接入方式平台化封装，平台改版不需要用户操心
highlights.en: Integrations are platformized — platform redesigns don't break your setup

cons.zh: 依赖第三方平台接口，长期稳定性存在不确定性
cons.en: Relies on third-party platform APIs; long-term stability is uncertain

fitFor.zh: 需要让本地 agent 联网获取实时信息的用户
fitFor.en: Users who want local agents to fetch live web info

fitFor.zh: 做多平台内容聚合/监控的自动化玩家
fitFor.en: Automators aggregating content across platforms

entries.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.

Google - Gemini 3.8 Flash, 3.1 Pro, Antigravity. xAI - Grok, Grok Bot, Cursor, Kimi and more! Updated regularly. A project in the AI agent ecosystem, mainly written in JavaScript, focused on ai, AI Agents, ai-prompts, Anthropic.

highlights.zh: 更新极快，几乎与新模型发布同步
highlights.en: Extremely fast updates, nearly in sync with new model releases

highlights.zh: 按厂商/产品分目录组织，检索友好
highlights.en: Organized by vendor/product directories, easy to navigate

highlights.zh: 已被主流媒体与学术机构引用
highlights.en: Already cited by major media and research institutions

cons.zh: 内容为泄露性质，合规与可用性风险需自行评估

entries.name: deepseek-harness

why.zh: 「deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness」是 AI Agent 生态里的通用项目；聚焦 AI Agent、cordis、dsh、dsh-plugin 等方向；主要使用 TypeScript。
why.en: DeepSeek Harness: Everything is a Plugin. A project in the AI agent ecosystem, mainly written in TypeScript, focused on AI Agents, cordis, dsh, dsh-plugin.

highlights.zh: 大厂官方出品 + 学术论文背书，工程与理论双支撑
highlights.en: Official release from a major lab, backed by an academic paper

highlights.zh: 插件化架构天然利于生态扩展（dsh-plugin 话题已上线）

highlights.en: Multiple run modes (Web UI, SSH, headless) plus an official docs site

fitFor.zh: 想自建 agent 平台而非拼凑框架的团队

why.en: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond. entries.name: OmniRoute

why.zh: 「diegosouzapw/OmniRoute」是 AI Agent 生态里的通用项目；聚焦 a2a、AI Agent、ai-gateway、Anthropic 等方向；主要使用 TypeScript。
why.en: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 359 providers (150+ free), 1200+ models Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by hundreds of contributors. A project in the AI agent ecosystem, mainly written in TypeScript, focused on a2a, AI Agents, ai-gateway, Anthropic.

highlights.zh: 免费额度目录化 + 预算仪表盘，数字算得明明白白
highlights.en: Cataloged free tiers + budget dashboard with transparent math

highlights.zh: 对标商业网关（LiteLLM/OpenRouter）的自托管替代
highlights.en: A self-hosted alternative benchmarked against LiteLLM/OpenRouter

highlights.zh: 带完整 dashboard 截图与架构图，文档投入大
highlights.en: Full dashboard screenshots and architecture diagrams — serious docs effort

cons.zh: 免费档位政策变动频繁，维护负担重
cons.en: Free-tier policies churn often — heavy maintenance burden

fitFor.zh: 多工具并用、想统一端点与路由的重度 AI 用户
fitFor.en: Heavy AI users unifying endpoints across many tools

fitFor.zh: 预算敏感的个人开发者与小团队
fitFor.en: Budget-sensitive indie developers and small teams
